observability_triage.rationale: An unlocked OOXML date content control can be inspected statically, but the requested acceptance of regular Enter is an interactive Microsoft Word behavior. The current pre-repo does not expose key input, commit behavior, or the resulting persisted date value, and the source does not define whether Enter means multiline input or keyboard commit.
repair_requirements: Freeze the intended date-field interaction sequence, including the typed date and role of the Enter key.
Provide pinned Word automation that focuses the date content control, types the fixture value, presses regular Enter, saves, and exposes the persisted OOXML result.

evidence: src/artifact_runtime.py serializes fields but has no keyboard-interaction entrypoint.
The target requirement concerns regular Enter input rather than only the presence of w:date markup.
The work item does not disambiguate multiline Enter from committing a typed date.
missing_observables: Result of pressing regular Enter after a typed valid date
Saved w:fullDate/display text after the interaction
minimum_environment_repairs: Add a pinned Word keyboard-automation surface and a hashed date-input fixture.
Specify the expected Enter semantics and day/month/year example.
blocker_or_exclusion.reentry_condition: Re-author criteria once regular Enter has a frozen interaction definition and the harness can observe the saved date-control result in Word and OOXML.

uncovered_items.evidence: No executable Word input surface exists to distinguish a merely unlocked date control from one satisfying the requested Enter behavior.
uncovered_items.required_action: Add the specified Word interaction fixture before validator authoring.
